description: Estimate a less-than-truckload rate using FreightFA's CzarLite-basis tariff calculator. Returns a directional benchmark for planning. Each call counts as one estimate toward the account's monthly FreightFA allowance.

commodity.description: Commodity description, or null for general freight.

distance.description: Lane distance in miles. recommend_mode returns it for a city or ZIP pair.

freight_class.description: NMFC freight class such as '70', '92.5', '175'. Null to use the default class.

name: estimate_ltl_rate
title: Estimate LTL rate
